newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares end mixed in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares end mixed in continuous trade.

text.p: Three stocks fell, two rose and five were flat in 5.8-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Thursday.
The remaining 11 stocks did not trade.
NFI units fell 1.4 percent to 144.5 zlotys in a 29.7-million-zloty turnover.
The continuous trading system, which currently lists 21 companies, is separate from the bourse's main single-price auction system in which the same firms and 62 others are traded.
At the single-price auction session most stocks rose and the main market's index gained 1.3 percent.
